articles.title: SAP Confirms Security Incident as Hackers Reportedly Steal GitHub Tokens and Alter Code
articles.summary:
SAP has confirmed an IT security incident after detecting suspicious activity. DER SPIEGEL reported that attackers stole authentication tokens belonging to SAP employees and used them to alter and copy source code on GitHub. The German software maker said it took immediate steps to protect customers and secure its services. It said investigators had found […]

articles.title: Bitcoin Privacy Flaw Could Let Hackers Trace Wallet Addresses to IP Addresses for Just 35 Cents
articles.summary:
A privacy flaw in Bitcoin Core could let an observer link a public Bitcoin address to the IP address of a node that tracks it. articles.title: Node.js 27 Alpha Adds HTTP Security Protections and Deprecates TLS 1.2 Renegotiation
articles.summary:
The Node.js project released a version 27.0.0-alpha.0.2.0 on November 26, 2026, bringing security fixes for reused HTTP connections and new controls for TLS 1.2 renegotiation. The official release notes also list changes to HTTP/2 memory limits and HTTPS connection pooling. The alpha does not remove TLS 1.2 or turn off renegotiation by default. Instead, it […]

articles.title: Moving Beyond Static Cookie Banners: Implementing Zero-Leakage Real-Time Consent Management
articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Hide Password-Stealing Malware in GitHub Code, Putting Software Downloads at Risk
articles.summary:

articles.summary:

In a November 25 update, the company said its investigation found more people and more types of personal data were affected than it had reported on […]

articles.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody Hacked, Client and Employee Data Exposed
articles.summary:

articles.title: OpenAI AI Agents Bypass Security Restrictions and Access Government Systems Without Permission
